content:
John's waiting on word from me that Las Palmas 8D is finally ready, and I told him I'd have it closed out today. From what I've picked up the punch-list got knocked out and the carpet's in, so on paper it looks about there. The thing is this turn has been dragging since May and a bunch of people have had a hand in it, and I don't want to walk up to John and call it done only to have something come back on me a week later.

Before I go to him, can you figure out where 8D really stands. Everything that was supposed to happen on that unit, confirm where each piece actually landed instead of going off what someone said in passing, and if something's still open, run down whatever it's waiting on and get it moving so it can genuinely close.

Then square up what we've got logged so it matches where the unit really is right now, because I'd bet some of it is stale by now. Post an update in the make-ready channel so the crew isn't working off old info. And draft John an email laying out where 8D stands, what's still outstanding if anything, and what it'll take to finish, so he's got the straight story from me.

I'd much rather catch whatever's still hanging now than after I've already told him it's ready.
I will search local files, Airtable bases, Linear issues, Slack channels, and Gmail threads to investigate
the current status and history of Las Palmas 8D.
